description:
“Lost Media” refers to media that has been forgotten. Accord is a shop that presents such lost media to people. Rika, the beautiful clerk at Accord, brings back the very pieces of lost media each customer is searching for and shows them once more. But isn’t there always a reason something was forgotten? The reason we erased those media from our memories was because they were horrific— and the moment customers come face to face with them again, they…
